situations.title: 전해질 패널 추세 사정
situations.tagline: You keep drawing his blood — are his salt levels still off?
situations.brief: K·Na·Ca·Mg·PO4 등 전해질 패널의 추세를 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: We check his electrolytes to see how his body is balancing.
Potassium, sodium, and others need to stay in a safe range.
Following the trend helps us correct problems safely.

situations.title: 정맥 보충 안전 투여
situations.tagline: That potassium bag looks strong — is it safe to run into her vein like that?
situations.brief: 농도·속도·라인을 지켜 정맥 전해질 보충을 안전하게 투여하세요.
keyPhrases: We give potassium slowly and at a safe concentration.
It goes through the right line to protect her vein and heart.
I'm monitoring her closely while it infuses.
goals: 전해질 보충을 안전한 농도와 속도로 투여한다

situations.title: 심전도 전해질 변화 인지
situations.tagline: I'm seeing peaked T waves on his monitor — let's check his potassium.
situations.brief: T파와 QT 변화를 통해 심전도의 전해질 변화를 인지하세요.
keyPhrases: These peaked T waves can mean high potassium.
A long QT can point to low potassium, magnesium, or calcium.
Let's send a stat electrolyte panel and tell the team.

situations.title: 원인 병력·약물 검토
situations.tagline: She's on a water pill at home — could that be why her levels are off?
situations.brief: 유발인자 파악을 위해 원인 병력과 약물을 검토하세요.
keyPhrases: Some medicines, like diuretics, can change her electrolyte levels.
We're reviewing her history and drugs to find the cause.
Knowing the trigger helps us correct and prevent it.

situations.title: 교정 중 재검·모니터
situations.tagline: You're drawing labs again already — how often do you need to recheck?
situations.brief: 추적 주기에 맞춰 교정 중 재검과 모니터를 시행하세요.
keyPhrases: We recheck the levels to make sure the correction is working.
Frequent labs help us avoid over- or under-correcting.
It's a normal part of keeping him safe during treatment.

situations.title: 증상 사정
situations.tagline: My arms and legs feel so weak and heavy — is that from the imbalance?
situations.brief: 근력·의식과의 임상 상관을 통해 전해질 증상을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: Electrolyte imbalances can cause weakness like you're feeling.
Can you squeeze my hands so I can check your strength?
Tell me if you feel confused, cramping, or your heart racing.

situations.title: 고칼륨혈증 단계별 관리
situations.tagline: His potassium is high — let's walk through stabilize, shift, and remove.
situations.brief: 안정화·이동·제거의 단계로 고칼륨혈증을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: First we give calcium to stabilize the heart.
Then insulin with glucose to shift potassium into the cells.
Finally we remove it with diuretics or dialysis.

situations.title: 저칼륨혈증 보충·부정맥 예방
situations.tagline: Her potassium is low and she's having ectopy — should we replace magnesium too?
situations.brief: Mg 동반 보정으로 저칼륨혈증을 보충하고 부정맥을 예방하세요.
keyPhrases: Low potassium can trigger dangerous arrhythmias.
We often replace magnesium too, or the potassium won't correct.
Let's replace both and watch her rhythm closely.

situations.title: 저나트륨 교정 속도 관리
situations.tagline: His sodium is really low — let's make sure we don't correct it too fast.
situations.brief: 삼투성 탈수초 예방을 위해 저나트륨 교정 속도를 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Correcting sodium too quickly can cause brain injury.
We limit the rise to a safe amount over 24 hours.
Let's recheck the sodium frequently and adjust the rate.

situations.title: 고나트륨 자유수 결핍 교정
situations.tagline: Her sodium is high from dehydration — how do we calculate her free water deficit?
situations.brief: 속도와 경로를 고려해 고나트륨 자유수 결핍을 교정하세요.
keyPhrases: We estimate her free water deficit to guide replacement.
Sodium should come down slowly to protect the brain.
Let's choose the route and recheck the level regularly.

situations.title: 저마그네슘·부정맥 연계
situations.tagline: Her magnesium is low and the QT is stretching — are we heading toward TdP?
situations.brief: TdP 예방을 위해 저마그네슘과 부정맥을 연계해 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Low magnesium with a long QT raises the risk of Torsades.
Let's replace magnesium and review QT-prolonging drugs.
We'll keep her on the monitor and have magnesium ready.

situations.title: 저·고칼슘 증상 관리
situations.tagline: His fingers keep spasming — could that be from low calcium?
situations.brief: 이온화 Ca를 기준으로 저·고칼슘 증상을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Muscle spasms and tingling can mean low calcium.
Let's check the ionized calcium, not just the total.
We'll replace it carefully and watch for symptom relief.

situations.title: 저인산혈증 관리
situations.tagline: His phosphate is low and he seems weak on the vent — could that be related?
situations.brief: 호흡근과 재영양을 고려해 저인산혈증을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Low phosphate can weaken the breathing muscles.
It often drops during refeeding, so we watch closely.
Let's replace it and recheck to support his weaning.

situations.title: 재영양증후군 예방 감시
situations.tagline: He's severely malnourished — should we start feeds slowly to avoid refeeding syndrome?
situations.brief: refeeding 위험을 고려해 재영양증후군을 예방하고 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: Starting feeds too fast can crash his phosphate, potassium, and magnesium.
We advance nutrition slowly and replace electrolytes first.
Let's monitor his labs closely as we start feeding.

situations.title: 종양용해증후군 대사 관리
situations.tagline: He just started chemo and his potassium and phosphate are climbing — is this tumor lysis?
situations.brief: TLS 감시를 통해 종양용해증후군의 대사 이상을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Rising potassium, phosphate, and uric acid suggest tumor lysis.
Let's ensure aggressive fluids and check for low calcium.
We'll monitor labs closely and involve the team early.

situations.title: 생명위협 고칼륨혈증 위기
situations.tagline: 환자는 생명을 위협하는 고칼륨혈증으로 심전도가 사인파형으로 악화되어 응급 안정화와 투석이 시급하다.
situations.brief: 응급 안정화와 투석으로 생명위협 고칼륨혈증 위기에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: His ECG is showing a sine wave — this is life-threatening.
Give calcium now to stabilize the heart, then insulin and glucose.
Let's activate emergent dialysis to remove the potassium.

situations.title: 급격 저나트륨 경련 위기
situations.tagline: 환자는 급격한 저나트륨혈증으로 경련이 발생해 고장성식염 투여와 주의 깊은 교정이 시급하다.
situations.brief: 고장성식염과 주의교정으로 급격 저나트륨 경련 위기에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: He's seizing from acute severe hyponatremia.
Let's give hypertonic saline per protocol to stop the seizures.
We must limit the total correction to avoid brain injury.

situations.title: 삼투성 탈수초증 위기
situations.tagline: 환자는 저나트륨의 과교정으로 삼투성 탈수초증 징후가 나타나 즉각적 대응이 필요하다.
situations.brief: 과교정 대응으로 삼투성 탈수초증 위기를 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: His sodium rose too fast, and he's showing neurologic changes.
We may need to relower the sodium with free water or DDAVP.
Let's involve the team urgently and monitor him closely.

situations.title: 심한 저마그네슘 TdP 위기
situations.tagline: 환자는 심한 저마그네슘혈증으로 Torsades de Pointes가 발생해 응급 마그네슘 투여가 시급하다.
situations.brief: 응급 Mg 투여로 심한 저마그네슘 TdP 위기에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: This is Torsades — give IV magnesium now.
Let's have the defibrillator ready and call for help.
We'll correct the magnesium and any other deficits fast.
goals: 응급 Mg 투여와 제세동 준비를 시행한다

situations.title: 저칼슘 후두경련·발작 위기
situations.tagline: 환자는 심한 저칼슘혈증으로 후두경련과 발작이 발생해 응급 칼슘 투여가 시급하다.
situations.brief: 응급 Ca 투여로 저칼슘 후두경련과 발작 위기에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Severe low calcium is causing laryngospasm and seizures.
Give IV calcium now and protect his airway.
Let's monitor his heart and recheck the ionized calcium.
goals: 응급 Ca 투여와 기도 보호를 시행한다

situations.title: 다중 전해질 붕괴 다장기 위기
situations.tagline: 환자는 여러 전해질이 동시에 붕괴하며 다장기 기능이 악화되어 우선순위 결정과 에스컬레이션이 시급하다.
situations.brief: 우선순위와 에스컬레이션으로 다중 전해질 붕괴 다장기 위기에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Multiple electrolytes are critically off and his organs are failing.
Let's treat the most life-threatening one first — the potassium.
We need to escalate to the intensivist and consider dialysis.
